title: Moqueca (Brazilian fish stew with coconut milk)
steps: Cut the fish into large pieces and marinate with lime juice, garlic and salt for 15 minutes.
Cook the rice according to the packet.
Slice the onion, tomatoes and pepper and layer them in a wide pot alternating with the fish and prawns.
Pour over the coconut milk, dendê oil and chilli and simmer gently, covered, for 15 minutes without stirring.
Sprinkle with coriander and serve with rice.
